hypotheses.statement: Combinatorial (3-way) suites find low-order interaction faults with far fewer tests than exhaustive testing.
hypotheses.evidence: n=10: 18 tests detect 100% of <=3-way faults vs 768 feasible configs for exhaustive; n=15: 23 tests detect 100% of <=3-way faults vs 24576 feasible configs for exhaustive; n=20: 28 tests detect 100% of <=3-way faults vs 593101 feasible configs for exhaustive; n=30: 34 tests detect 99% of <=3-way faults (exhaustive infeasible to run)

hypotheses.statement: Risk-weighted prioritization finds more faults earlier than random testing at the same budget.
hypotheses.evidence: n=10 colocate=0.7: risk 92% / NAPFD 0.65 vs random 67% / 0.43; n=15 colocate=0.7: risk 93% / NAPFD 0.65 vs random 72% / 0.45; n=20 colocate=0.0: risk 84% / NAPFD 0.61 vs random 76% / 0.48; n=20 colocate=0.7: risk 90% / NAPFD 0.64 vs random 76% / 0.48; n=30 colocate=0.7: risk 92% / NAPFD 0.68 vs random 76% / 0.50

hypotheses.statement: Minimization yields much smaller, correct reproduction conditions.
hypotheses.evidence: n=10 colocate=0.7: 93% exact, core 2.5667 literals vs raw counterexample diff 7.9, 60.6833 extra tests; n=15 colocate=0.7: 93% exact, core 2.7167 literals vs raw counterexample diff 12.55, 57.2833 extra tests; n=20 colocate=0.0: 97% exact, core 2.6667 literals vs raw counterexample diff 18.2604, 66.6979 extra tests; n=20 colocate=0.7: 97% exact, core 2.7071 literals vs raw counterexample diff 18.0404, 69.4747 extra tests; n=30 colocate=0.7: 99% exact, core 2.6812 literals vs raw counterexample diff 27.2101, 76.2609 extra tests

hypotheses.statement: The Agent Skill reduces context and tool calls for the same verification task.
